lines.text: Did you know? Sens is Latin for feel.
Quick quiz! Which means together plus feel?

words.ex: All participants gave written consent before the study.
Consumer sentiment improved in the second quarter as unemployment fell.

publish.title: Sens root: consent and sentiment
publish.value: Sens comes from Latin "sentire" (to feel). Words: consent and sentiment. consent = con + sent.
